title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master to drive the end\-to\-end delivery of software and product initiatives across cross\-functional engineering teams.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of Technical Project Management, Scrum/Agile leadership, delivery management, and technical understanding. This role will be responsible for planning and coordinating multiple work streams, managing dependencies and risks, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and ensuring predictable delivery across engineering, Product, QA, and other stakeholder groups.


The candidate should be comfortable working in a technically complex product environment and collaborating closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Developers, QA, Business Stakeholders, and other technical teams.


This is a delivery\-focused role requiring someone who can operate at both the project/program level and team level, while maintaining strong visibility into timelines, dependencies, risks, priorities, and delivery outcomes.

 **Job Responsibilities**

1\. Project \& Delivery Management

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of software projects from planning and estimation through development, testing, UAT, and production release.
* Define project scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, priorities, and delivery objectives.
* Create and maintain project plans, release plans, roadmaps, and delivery schedules.
* Track progress against milestones, commitments, and release objectives.
* Identify delivery risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers and drive them toward resolution.
* Manage scope changes and assess their impact on timelines, resources, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate multiple technical workstreams and ensure alignment across teams.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, action items, RAID logs, and delivery dashboards.
* Provide clear and timely communication on project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes to stakeholders.
* Ensure delivery commitments are clearly understood and tracked across Product and Engineering.


2\. Scrum Master \& Agile Leadership

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including:
	+ Sprint Planning
	+ Daily Scrum
	+ Backlog Refinement
	+ Sprint Review / Demo
	+ Sprint Retrospective
* Ensure teams understand and work toward clearly defined Sprint Goals.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritized, and actionable Product Backlog.
* Ensure user stories have clear requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and Definition of Done before development begins.
* Identify and remove impediments affecting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Promote Agile principles, transparency, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on effective Scrum and Agile practices.
* Monitor sprint execution and identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Help teams improve predictability, planning accuracy, and delivery consistency.


3\. Technical \& Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate delivery across Frontend, Backend, Mobile, QA, and other technical teams.
* Work closely with Technical Leads, Engineering Managers, and developers to understand technical dependencies, implementation constraints, and delivery risks.
* Facilitate effective communication between Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate development readiness, code reviews, QA testing, regression testing, UAT, and release activities.
* Track cross\-team technical dependencies and ensure blockers are actively managed.
* Participate in technical discussions and help ensure technical decisions are aligned with delivery objectives.
* Understand software development lifecycle, APIs, databases, cloud environments, integrations, and modern application architectures.
* Translate technical dependencies and risks into clear project\-level impact for stakeholders.


4\. QA, UAT \& Release Management

* Coordinate development and QA activities throughout the release lifecycle.
* Ensure defects, rework, regression activities, and technical debt are appropriately tracked and prioritized.
* Coordinate UAT planning, execution, and issue resolution.
* Track release readiness and required quality gates.
* Coordinate production deployment activities with relevant engineering and operational teams.
* Ensure release dependencies and approvals are identified and completed on time.
* Track post\-release issues, feedback, and follow\-up actions.


5\. Metrics, Reporting \& Delivery Insights

* Monitor and analyze Agile and project delivery metrics, including:
	+ Sprint Capacity
	+ Velocity
	+ Burndown / Burnup
	+ Cycle Time
	+ Throughput
	+ Defect Trends
* QA Rework
* Milestone Progress
* Delivery Predictability
* Build and maintain Jira dashboards, filters, and reports for project and sprint visibility.
* Provide actionable insights to Product and Engineering leadership based on delivery data.
* Identify delivery trends and potential schedule or capacity risks early.
* Maintain clear reporting on project health, milestones, dependencies, risks, and blockers.

 **Job Requirements:**

**Skills \& Experience**

* 8–12\+ years of experience in software project management, technical project management, Agile delivery, or a related role.
* Strong hands\-on experience as a Technical Project Manager, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or similar delivery leadership role.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Proven experience managing cross\-functional software development teams.
* Experience coordinating Frontend, Backend, QA, and other technical teams.
* Strong experience in project planning, estimation, capacity planning, milestone tracking, and release planning.
* Strong experience with risk, issue, dependency, and scope management.
* Experience coordinating QA, UAT, production releases, and post\-release activities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to create and maintain Jira dashboards, filters, reports, and delivery metrics.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and communicate effectively with engineering teams.
* Strong analytical, documentation, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced product development environment.  
* 

  

**Preferred Technical Exposure**

Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:

* React / Angular
* Node.js
* Ruby / Ruby on Rails
* MongoDB
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* Redis
* Elasticsearch
* REST APIs and backend services
* Cloud\-based applications and AWS/GCP
* SaaS / Enterprise applications
* AI\-enabled product development


Note: This is not a hands\-on developer position. However, the candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to communicate effectively with engineering teams, understand architecture and technical dependencies, identify delivery risks, and translate technical challenges into project\-level impact.

 **Tools \& Platforms**

* Jira
* Confluence
* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
* Project planning and reporting tools
* Dashboard and analytics tools
* AI\-assisted productivity and project management tools

 **Certifications**

* Preferred certifications include: CSM – Certified ScrumMaster, PMI\-ACP, PMP
* Certifications are preferred but should not substitute for strong practical Agile and delivery experience.

 **Work Schedule:**


Monday through Friday from 12 PM to 9 PM IST. This will provide healthy overlap between India team and US team and supporting both to ensure adequate collaboration. This role will be working in Hybrid Mode and will require at least 2 days’ work from office at Hyderabad.

JOB DESCRIPTION
  
We are looking for a structured, analytical and proactive individual to independently manage lower\-complexity projects and to support Project Managers in the execution and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) initiatives across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will bring clarity through data, planning and disciplined tracking in environments where stakeholders and requirements are still evolving, ensuring that Business Leads, Tech Leads and cross\-functional teams have an accurate and timely view of progress, risks and decisions. The role is the analytical and governance engine of the Projects team – owning project plans, RAID logs, toll\-gate evidence, KPI and capacity reporting and the project management tooling that the team runs on. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Project Planning \& Execution Support
  
  

Independently manage assigned low\-to\-medium complexity projects (e.g. Transition Lite work transfers, single\-workstream change or process improvement initiatives, ad hoc GCD initiatives) from discovery through to closure, using the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks
  
Act as the delivery partner to a Project Manager on large or critical Transition and Transformation projects, owning defined workstreams, deliverables and follow\-ups end to end
  
Build and maintain integrated project plans, milestone schedules and detailed transition plans (deliverables, dates and named owners) and keep them baselined and current as scope evolves
  
Track delivery against scope, schedule and success criteria and flag variances to the Project Manager / Head of Projects early, with proposed corrective actions
  
  

Governance, Toll Gates \& Decision Support
  
  

Own the toll\-gate evidence pack for assigned projects – tracking TG1/TG2/TG3 artefacts (Transition Acceptance Form, Regulatory \& Client Consent assessment, Tech/IT inventory, KC/KT plan, training sign\-offs, Go\-Live approval) and ensuring evidence is complete, filed and sign\-offs secured on time
  
Prepare materials for Tier 2 (weekly tactical) and Tier 3 (operational) governance forums – agendas, status packs, action and decision logs – and facilitate Tier 3 forums for projects you own
  
Maintain decision logs capturing what was decided, by whom (Business / Tech / PM), when and why, and follow through on resulting actions
  
Contribute to the Tier 1 (monthly strategic oversight) and PMO review packs by consolidating status, risks, escalations and change requests across the portfolio
  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency \& Action Management
  
  

Maintain the RAID log (risks, assumptions/actions, issues, dependencies) for assigned projects, categorising by type (business / technical / execution) and impact, and driving owners to closure
  
Analyse trends across risks and issues to identify systemic blockers and cross\-project dependencies, and bring them to the Project Manager / Head of Projects with options
  
Prepare escalation notes that clearly state the blocker, impact, options and decision required, for use in the appropriate governance tier
  
Co\-create mitigation plans with Business Leads, Tech Leads and cross\-functional teams (TA, Academy, IT, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Control Tower)
  
  

Reporting, KPIs \& Capacity Analytics
  
  

Produce accurate, insight\-led status reporting – weekly project updates, executive dashboards and the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update – for the Head of Projects, Executive Sponsors and Business / Tech Leads
  
Define, collect and analyse project KPIs (timeline adherence, milestone delivery, hiring and onboarding progress, KC/KT scorecards, controlled production results) and turn them into clear recommendations
  
Support capacity and headcount reporting – tracking Budget\-to\-Hire, FTE moves across locations and GCD location capacity utilisation in partnership with Control Tower and Workforce Planning
  
Build and maintain Power BI / Excel dashboards and reporting templates so that portfolio\-level reporting is consistent, repeatable and largely automated
  
  

Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication
  
  

Coordinate day\-to\-day with Business Leads, Tech Leads, CD Leads, Transformation Leads and cross\-functional teams across global delivery locations to gather inputs, validate status and close actions
  
Maintain living stakeholder maps and RACI for assigned projects, identifying stakeholders that emerge during execution and adjusting engagement accordingly
  
Draft clear, concise project communications – kick\-off notes, status updates, change notices, minutes of meetings – appropriate to executive and operational audiences
  
Surface business decisions to Business Leads and technical decisions to Tech Leads, while taking execution\-level decisions within the agreed plan independently
  
  

Scope, Change \& Transition Support
  
  

Support scope discovery and Control Tower intake – helping LoB / BPAs complete intake forms, documenting scope, assumptions and impacted teams, and highlighting overlaps, gaps or conflicts
  
Log, assess and track change requests, including impact on timeline, effort and headcount, and route them through the appropriate approval tier
  
Track Knowledge Capture / Knowledge Transfer (KC/KT) execution, training completion and access provisioning against plan for transitions from global high\-cost locations to Client Delivery centres
  
Prepare Go/No\-Go readiness assessments and support post\-project reviews, capturing lessons learnt and feeding them back into the team's frameworks, checklists and templates
  
  

PMO Frameworks, Tools \& Continuous Improvement
  
  

Administer and continuously improve the team's project management toolset – Jira boards and workflows, Confluence project spaces, SharePoint evidence libraries and reporting templates
  
Maintain the Transition Framework, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates and Transition Acceptance Document templates, incorporating lessons learnt and stakeholder feedback
  
Coach Project Officers on tools, templates and governance standards and review the quality of their trackers and reports
  
  

PROFILE
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Engineering or related field; MBA or equivalent an advantage
  
Project management certification such as CAPM / PMP (in progress), PRINCE2 Foundation/Practitioner, Agile / Scrum or Six Sigma Green Belt preferred
  
Overall 8\-13 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
  
4\-7 years of project management and execution experience – running projects or workstreams independently in a project, PMO or transition role
  
Exposure to transitions, work transfers, process migrations or change programmes in a global delivery / captive centre environment strongly preferred (US/EMEA or multi\-geography stakeholder experience an advantage)
  
  

Technical Skills
  
  

Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, data modelling) and Power BI for KPI dashboards and portfolio reporting; strong PowerPoint for executive\-ready status packs
  
Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools – Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, MS Teams, MS Project or equivalent planning tools
  
Working knowledge of project management methodologies (waterfall, agile, hybrid) and of RAID, RACI and toll\-gate / decision\-gate governance
  
Basic understanding of Tech, application and access / infrastructure dependencies on business projects helpful.

title: Program Manager III, Service Delivery Standard Work
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers (including our consumers, businesses, and drivers) across every interaction.  

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Service Delivery organization’s single threaded leader for CS Security. This role is responsible for owning the relationships with CS Security teams and the charter to empower associates whilst safeguarding customer data. You closely partner with CS Security in identifying and mitigating information security risks across all Customer Service systems, data, people, assets, and capabilities. The role consults and executes CS Security's strategy from the evolution of customer and agent authentication, creation and enforcement of security policy, to development of multi\-layer security from servers to devices.  

  

* An ideal candidate will combine product management depth in customer service operations or security with a demonstrated ability to implement AI\-driven automation and modern project management tooling across distributed teams.
* You will partner with CS Security and Tech teams to define and design the end\-to\-end experience of associate and frontline leaders when security guardrails are applied. You will evaluate and improve existing tooling and processes and support the creation of new tech and AI driven solutions, consistently enhancing associate experiences and empowering our teams. You will work backward from security risks and associate pain points to design solutions and processes and define product requirements. Partnering with CS Security, engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams you will deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short\-term tactical improvements with long\-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience and empowerment.
* The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and/or security and deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross\-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering products that meet their customers’ needs. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.

  

This role can be located in Hyderabad.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the end\-to\-end CS Security partnership for Service Delivery
* Own the security\-related strategy and associate empowerment charter for Service Delivery
* Lead strategic planning processes, working with leaders across the organization to set goals, define priorities, and allocate resources.
* Write product requirements (PRFAQs, vision docs, BRDs, user stories) working backward from customer needs for both new launches and existing experience improvements.

Are you ready to join us and create the future? Come as you are, do what you love—start your journey with us today!

Work with the Area Project Manager to deliver engagements within an assigned Area.


Responsible for endtoend project financials, drive key performance metrics, proactively manage risks and issues with financials—including recovery actions—and ensure strong quality and changes required throughout delivery
